items.title: A Layman Thinks About AI
items.why: AI stocks drove this week's Nasdaq sell-off; Marks lays out the questions investors keep skipping.
note: Howard Marks's newest memo works through 11 questions around investing in AI, from who profits to what it means for credit markets.
His point: the answers are uncertain, but AI matters too much to ignore.

items.title: Does the Stock Market Stigmatize Banks that Borrow from the Fed?
items.publisher: New York Fed, Liberty Street Economics
items.why: Banks led this week's rally in India; this asks whether borrowing from a central bank in a crunch makes investors more nervous about a bank.
note: New York Fed economists track how stock investors judged banks that first borrowed from the Fed during the 2023 bank run.
After a first trip to the Fed's discount window, investors grew more sensitive to that bank's weak spots.

items.title: How 3 Million People Got Locked Out of their Bank
items.why: A short case study in what happens when a bank's systems fail its customers.
note: ColdFusion looks at how millions of people in Paraguay were locked out of their bank accounts in November 2026, and what went wrong.
